answer: Since the throttle counters live in the mirror ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 189 keys hence pays for 189 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the ridge quota and the pulse admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 7 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
